verdict.rationale: Fenwick has a dedicated Privacy & Cybersecurity practice page describing an integrated team of lawyers and former industry privacy and cybersecurity officers who provide compliance, assessment and implementation-focused services. That covers the core of the story: a documented privacy/cyber practice offering compliance counsel. However, the evidence is a single first-party statement. Missing for 10: explicit coverage of named regimes (GDPR, CCPA, India's DPDP Act or local equivalents), detail on the scope of privacy counseling services, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the practice.
